dates: May 2008 termination; March 2009 contract extension; March 2011 audit position

price_or_terms_change: Ten months of renegotiation failed; department terminated; incumbent maintenance charges for live systems doubled after termination.

cost_funder_and_release_authority: Central programme finance; GBP546m BT extension in March 2009 includes live-site support and new deployments. Appraisal prior to termination existed; not evidence of precommitted operational fallback.

alignment_with_harm_bearer: Central financial and acceptance powers; affected trusts and patients bear operational risk.

dates: 1998–1999 baseline; 2000–2001 crisis; June 2001 regional mitigation; 2002 complaint/audit
buyer_and_incumbent: Retail utilities, California ISO, state DWR, FERC, CPUC and multiple generators
price_or_terms_change: Wholesale power price rises in constrained market; bid caps/refusals and state procurement coexist with service emergencies.
fallback_before_change: Existing electricity infrastructure; insufficient reliable affordable alternative at full demand. No entirely independent funded standby system verified.
cost_funder_and_release_authority: Utilities and then state DWR purchases; no fully financed adequate fallback before crisis demonstrated. Wholesale exposure and capped retail recovery differ.
refusal_holder_and_legal_basis: ISO rejects bids/caps market offers; FERC controls wholesale regulation under Federal Power Act; CPUC complains under section 206. Residents have no individual refusal preserving power service.
harm_bearer: Electricity users, taxpayers and utilities; outages and high procurement bills affect different groups.
quantified_outcome_and_measurement_statu: CPUC complaint reports average USD33/MWh in 1998–1999 versus USD317/MWh December 2000; USD27bn 2000 wholesale costs versus about USD7bn 1999; 55 emergencies in 2000. Complaint claims attributed, not adjudicated.
activation_time_and_service: GAO links later price decline to multiple contemporaneous changes; caps alone do not establish reliable fallback or causal price recovery.
alignment_with_harm_bearer: Regulators/market operator and procurement funders separate from residents and some utilities.
limits_and_UNVERIFIED: Multiple suppliers, changing demand and generation make single-incumbent analogy weak. No formal model parameter calibration or independent causal cap effect.
